en_US: Hello? Hello? Hello? Hello?
...I think we have a bad connection.
Could you try again from another spot?
Nice to hear from you.
How is everything with you?
I’m good.
There are a lot more stronger
Gym Leaders than me...
So get tough or go home!
What’s your point?
If you want to battle me again, fine.
Friday nights, take it or leave it.
Call me then... Maybe I’ll answer...
Well, well, you called at the right time!
You want to battle again?
I’m up for it.{YESNO 0}
Ha ha ha.
It’s great that you’re stepping up.
I’ll be waiting for you at the
Fighting Dojo in Saffron City!
What in the world?
Are you trying to make fun of me?!
You figure you want to battle me?
I’m wondering if you have time enough
to do me justice.
I hear you made promises to meet some
other people. You should respect those
first, is what I think.
I’m waiting for you at the Fighting Dojo
in Saffron City...
Don’t wuss out.
Yes, it’s Clair here...
Oh, hi. How are you doing?
Keep in mind we’re meeting at the
Fighting Dojo in Saffron City.
It’s a promise I’m waiting to keep...
Lately some people from the
Radio Station came around, wanting to
do a piece on me, or something.
My fans definitely won’t want to
miss watching that!
Oh, no! I was confused! It’s radio!
All those people tuning in, and they
won’t be able to see my glorious face!
What about TV?
Why hasn’t a TV crew come to do a piece
on me?!
Lately there seems to be some gossip
running through town that I am the
latest name in fashion.
Well, if I’m that cool that people can’t
stop talking about me, I can totally
understand that sentiment.
Wow, you seem like you’re a pretty busy
person, aren’t you? Even more than
I am, if that could possibly be.
I mean, I’ve got my Gym work, and I’ve
got to go see the Elder at the
Dragon Tamer’s shrine, too.
What do you think?
You’ve got talent--you could become
a Dragon Tamer, too. Think so?
